verses.text: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

segments.text: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

verses.text: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;

segments.text: Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judah and his brethren;

verses.text: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;

segments.text: and Judah begat Perez and Zerah of Tamar; and Perez begat Hezron; and Hezron begat Ram;

verses.text: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;

segments.text: and Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon; and Nahshon begat Salmon;

verses.text: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

segments.text: and Salmon begat Boaz of Rahab; and Boaz begat Obed of Ruth; and Obed begat Jesse;

verses.text: and Jesse begat David the king. And David begat Solomon of her that had been the wife of Uriah;

verses.text: and Josiah begat Jechoniah and his brethren, at the time of the carrying away to Babylon.

verses.text: And after the carrying away to Babylon, Jechoniah begat Shealtiel; and Shealtiel begat Zerubbabel;

verses.text: and Jacob begat Joseph the husband of Mary, of whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

verses.text: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.

segments.text: So all the generations from Abraham unto David are fourteen generations; and from David unto the carrying away to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon unto the Christ fourteen generations.

verses.text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.

segments.text: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When his mother Mary had been betrothed to Joseph, before they came together she was found with child of the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

segments.text: And Joseph her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily.

verses.text: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

segments.text: But when he thought on these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying, Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife: for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

verses.text: And she shall bring forth a son; and thou shalt call his name JESUS; for it is he that shall save his people from their sins.

verses.text: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, And they shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.

verses.text: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;
